summary: double Dijkstra baselines return dist = inf (no parent) for a reachable vertex whose true distance exceeds DBL_MAX, a result verify_sssp rejects as reachable_but_infinite; bellman_ford throws std::overflow_error on the same input. WeightTraits<double>::checked_add is a plain addition, and nd < dist[v] silently drops nd = +inf. Expected: std::overflow_error, consistent with bellman_ford and the integer policy (docs/design/baselines.md).

found_by.test: independent review of WeightTraits<double>::checked_add (no random search)

failure.message: vertex 2 is reachable from the source but has dist = inf

expected: std::overflow_error from every baseline (as bellman_ford does)
